description: Defines classes and types for Metal-based convolution and linear operation contexts in PyTorch, including serialization and resource management.

classes.name: Conv2dOpContext
classes.description: Holds context and resources for a 2D convolution operation on Metal, including serialization and resource management.

classes.name: LinearOpContext
classes.description: Holds context and resources for a linear (fully connected) operation on Metal, including serialization and resource management.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the context data into a tuple for storage or transfer.

methods.name: release_resources
methods.description: Releases allocated resources, invoking the callback if set.

methods.name: set_conv2dOpPtr
methods.description: Sets the internal pointer to the convolution operation object.

methods.name: get_conv2dOpPtr
methods.description: Retrieves the internal pointer to the convolution operation object.

methods.name: set_releaseCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback function to release resources.

methods.name: get_releaseCallback
methods.description: Retrieves the current resource release callback.

methods.name: set_opaqueOpPtr
methods.description: Sets the internal pointer to the opaque operation object.

methods.name: get_opaqueOpPtr
methods.description: Retrieves the internal pointer to the opaque operation object.
